01a0b5a3-4e78-7513-b048-3291d6d2f45f.instruction: Ask which account detail they need, then call lookup_customer_info once. Wait for the actual lookup result. Read the returned detail, then succeed; fail for no request or failed lookup.
01a0b5a3-4e78-7513-b048-3291d6d2f45f.name: account_details

failure.next_instructions: Tell the caller the account details could not be retrieved, then goodbye.

success.next_instructions: Thank the caller and say goodbye.

01a0b5a3-4e78-7513-b048-32af582658fc.instruction: Ask for the caller's 4-digit PIN, read it back, then call verify_pin once. Wait for the actual verification result. Succeed only if it says the PIN was verified; fail for refusal, invalid PIN, or failed verification.
01a0b5a3-4e78-7513-b048-32af582658fc.name: verify_customer

failure.next_instructions: Say verification could not be completed, thank them, and say goodbye.
